summary: Re-pin after a clean rebase onto 37126b40 (main after #836). Re-verified, not re-stamped: base is the current main tip, all SEVEN commits carry the agent marker, and the diff against the new base is BYTE-IDENTICAL to the diff reviewed at 8c9de98d. ⭐ The byte-adoption commit e47b5fff is preserved as its own commit, so eod_counts.py fidelity against the box remains independently checkable - the same discipline that was lost and then restored on #831. Substance carried forward unchanged - ACCEPT after five rounds, 7/7 mutants killed, each target confirmed to occur exactly once before mutating. N1: the filled-intent CTE filters only intent_type='open'; ti.status='filled' is gone, so every open intent holding a real BUY fill is counted, and the test that DEFENDED the bug is INVERTED rather than removed. Mutant (i) re-adding the filter reproduces the exact production defect I measured - the filled entry vanishes, the first-rate prints 50.0 instead of 75.0, and it publishes as a GRADEABLE no-entry cross. N1b: the tautological RECONCILED verdict is deleted repo-wide; a line prints ONLY on disagreement. N2: no_entry_gradeable now requires slot_gradeable and the log verdict. N3: any ambiguous round trip downgrades, with ambiguous= and invalid_price= on both the per-account and VERDICT lines. N4: the five-state historical_log_verdict is implemented against the REAL reader and gates both the first-rate and no-entry sections, so a rotated log is no longer byte-identical to a quiet day. No remaining number in the file publishes a false zero. NON-BLOCKING follow-ups, all failing SAFE toward COULD_NOT_TELL: trips_verdict collapses to COULD_NOT_TELL whenever accounts mix GRADEABLE with UNEXERCISED, which with ORB decommissioned is the NORMAL daily shape - an UNEXERCISED account should not veto; a real zero-entry day cannot be graded although it is the most actionable EOD result there is; the no-entry detail truncates at 10 with no 'N more'; MEDIAN prints on the line after a COULD_NOT_TELL verdict so a copied median loses it; and _historical_log_verdict returns an UNVALIDATED getattr string. ⛔ DEPLOY: ops/** and scripts/ only - NO service restart. Needs a checkout sync and install_eod_counts.sh run, and it is #831's prerequisite because that installer refuses unless eod_counts.py is already installed.
